SOURCE & CRAFT

A transparent study.

This website and its 3D visualisation were created by Muhammad Rizky. Product references, textures, engines, and fonts are credited to their respective owners below.

Dimensions, product names, thumbnail photographs, and finishes are referenced from SIENNA CATALOGUE 2026.pdf by Living Ikon, supplied by the project owner. This is an independent reconstruction, not official manufacturer CAD or an official manufacturer website.

The open exhibition layout, display signs, hidden surfaces, joinery, sofa, chairs, and decorations are interpretations. The exhibition has no walls or roof. Colours, lighting, and hidden proportions cannot be guaranteed to match exactly from catalogue photographs alone.

Wood texture: Ash Veneer — Jenelle van Heerden / Poly Haven · CC0 ↗ The material is stained to interpret LCV09 Warm Brown. Geometry, woven textures, decorative artwork, and scripts were created for this project.

Browser engine: Three.js 0.186.1 · MIT. Draco decoder: Apache 2.0. Fonts: DM Sans and Instrument Serif, SIL Open Font License. Licences are available in assets/vendor/legal.

Product listing photographs are crops from the original catalogue. Exhibition gallery images are original Blender EEVEE renders at UHD 4K resolution. The Blender master scene also supports Cycles rendering. The browser displays optimised GLB models with real-time lighting; reflections are not planar ray-traced.

Catalogue discrepancy: the B51 tallboy is labelled “2 Over 4 Drawers”, but its photograph shows four drawer fronts. The model follows the visual reference. The L11 lamp table uses the 550 × 550 × 550 mm dimensions printed on page 5.
